image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a single flower head against a dark, blurred background. The flower features a large central disc composed of tightly packed florets that transition from a dark brown/black center to golden yellow edges. Surrounding the disc are numerous elongated, cream-colored ray petals radiating outward. The depth of field is shallow, with the center in sharp focus and the outer petals blurring into the background.

The transition between the central disc florets and the ray petals is slightly indistinct in the lower-left quadrant, where the geometry of the florets seems to melt into the base of the petals rather than having a clean biological separation.
